title: EdgeInventoryV1
description: GET /inventory (and edge file data/inventory.json): declared placement intent for tags this lab currently tracks. Not a camera measurement. Every key MUST exist in data/library.json. Coordinator active-tags.tag_ids is exactly the key set of this document (derived view — no separate active_catalog.json on the edge).

backend_id.description: Optional stamp when served over HTTP; may be omitted on disk.

entries.description: Map tag_id → declaration. Empty object means the lab tracks nothing yet.

placement.description: Declared home: on the breadboard, in inventory storage, or intentionally off-table / not placed.

storage_slot.description: Required when placement is storage; grid slot id or {i,j}. Null otherwise.

localize.description: If true (default), LOCALIZE_COMPONENTS includes this tag when args.tag_ids is omitted and placement is table or storage. Fixed fixtures that never move may set false.

notes.description: Human-facing lab note; ignored by the contract.
